fixture.source_data: Synthetic publisher-generated Settlement and empty Data Kiosk days; no seed copy

limitations: Synthetic100-company header distribution and copied validated report scopes, not observed traffic frequency.
Warm local sequential3-run medians; not concurrent or cold-cache capacity.
Publication timings include normal source resolution, child/FK/inventory work, and deferred verification, not isolated index-maintenance CPU.
No-secondary variant removes optional component and Settlement/terms reverse-pin indexes; constraint indexes and Data Kiosk retention index stay.
